title: Tiny, cute lighthouse
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sea / base water -->
  <rect x='8' y='76' width='84' height='16' rx='6' fill='#1e6fa8'/>
  <rect x='8' y='76' width='84' height='5' rx='3' fill='#3aa8e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='30' ry='3' fill='#2a8cc4'/>
  <!-- rocky island -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='22' ry='7' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='71' rx='18' ry='5' fill='#a89884'/>
  <!-- lighthouse body -->
  <path d='M41 71 L44 38 L56 38 L59 71 Z' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- red stripes -->
  <path d='M42.2 60 L57.8 60 L58.4 68 L41.6 68 Z' fill='#e8434b'/>
  <path d='M43.4 44 L56.6 44 L57.4 51 L42.6 51 Z' fill='#e8434b'/>
  <!-- shadow edge on body -->
  <path d='M54 38 L56 38 L59 71 L56 71 Z' fill='#d0d0d0'/>
  <!-- gallery ring -->
  <rect x='39' y='34' width='22' height='4' rx='2' fill='#9aa0a8'/>
  <!-- lamp room -->
  <rect x='43' y='24' width='14' height='10' rx='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <rect x='45' y='26' width='10' height='6' rx='1' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <!-- glow beams -->
  <path d='M45 27 L10 18 L10 26 Z' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.55'/>
  <path d='M55 27 L90 18 L90 26 Z' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- roof -->
  <path d='M42 24 L50 12 L58 24 Z' fill='#d63a3a'/>
  <path d='M50 12 L58 24 L54 24 Z' fill='#b02a2a'/>
  <!-- roof tip -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='11' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='47' y='62' width='6' height='9' rx='2' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <rect x='47' y='62' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#9a7a5a'/>
  <!-- windows -->
  <rect x='48' y='53' width='4' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#3aa8e0'/>
  <!-- waves -->
  <path d='M15 82 Q22 78 29 82 Q36 86 43 82' stroke='#5cd0f0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M57 82 Q64 78 71 82 Q78 86 85 82' stroke='#5cd0f0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
